headline: Taiwan Stocks Correct: 13 Listed Financial Holding Companies Earn NT$51.894 Billion in July, Second-Lowest Single-Month Figure This Year | Industry
summary: Thirteen listed Taiwan financial holding companies earned NT$51.894 billion in July, the second-lowest monthly figure this year, as the TAIEX fell 6% in the month.
why: Financial holding companies combine banking, securities and insurance operations, so their earnings track both lending activity and capital market valuations.

impacts.name: TAIEX
impacts.why: The index fell 6% in July, which hit securities subsidiaries' single-month profits and financial asset valuations.
